plugins.name: claude-dejavu
plugins.description: Memory + recovery + code grounding. Restores deleted sessions, hybrid PG+Weaviate recall across every past conversation, tree-sitter symbol indexing across 12 languages, eight identifier-grounding domains (env / DB / route / GraphQL / flag / CSS / i18n / module-export), and a 14-strategy deterministic rewriter that catches fabrications before disk write. 89.3% reduction in hallucinated identifiers (51.5% → 5.5%, n=400).
